# Anne Shirley & Leslie Moore

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Comrade of — [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) — rambles and fireside communings · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002)</sub>
- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md) — close friends and confidantes · since v4  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P42](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 15 CHRISTMAS AT FOUR WINDS P6](../source/v04-c15.md#nw-v04-c15-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002), +12 more</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes for an evening walk along the shore and encounters [Leslie Moore](../character/leslie-moore.md), whom she discovers is her striking neighbor instead of an older housewife as she had assumed. The two women converse, exchange names, and discuss their perspectives on life, though [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) shows mixed feelings of warmth and emotional distance. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns home to recount the surprising encounter to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P4](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P10](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P51](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0051), [v4 CHAPTER 10 LESLIE MOORE P58](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0058)_

> [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the house of dreams for a pleasant evening by the fire. She relaxes and opens up as they talk about books and offer to lend her theirs, though she abruptly retreats into sadness as she leaves. Afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) share a sweet moment discussing Leslie's beauty and Anne's hair.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P5](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P8](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P13](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 12 LESLIE COMES OVER P18](../source/v04-c12.md#nw-v04-c12-p0018)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks through a gloomy fog to visit [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), leaving [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) behind while he attends a meeting in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). Upon arrival, she witnesses [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) weeping bitterly inside and decides not to intrude. On her way back, she meets Captain Jim bringing [Dick](../character/dick.md) home, and Captain Jim walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) safely back to her house.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P0](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P5](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P6](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 13 A GHOSTLY EVENING P7](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0007)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) spend pleasant autumn evenings at the lighthouse with Captain Jim and [First Mate](../character/first-mate.md). Walking home afterward, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) discuss Leslie's potential, tease each other about past suitors, and look forward to the coming spring at their lit home.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P4](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P7](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P18](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0018)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) head to the [Four Winds Point](../codex/places.md#four-winds-point) lighthouse to ring in the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) with Captain Jim. They are joined by [Marshall Elliott](../character/marshall.md), who dances with [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) to Captain Jim's fiddle playing. As midnight arrives, the group opens the door to welcome the [New Year](../codex/places.md#new-year) together.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P3](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P6](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P11](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P21](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0021)_

> During the winter at [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on the emotional barrier and occasional resentment she senses from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), despite their shared activities and Leslie's gift of handmade baby clothes. Meanwhile, Captain Jim shows [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) his written life-book, which she realizes could be made into a great masterpiece by the right writer.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P2](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P11](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P12](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 17 A FOUR WINDS WINTER P21](../source/v04-c17.md#nw-v04-c17-p0021)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) goes into labor and gives birth to a baby girl, whom she and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) name Joyce. However, the baby dies shortly after birth, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken and struggling through a painful recovery.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P7](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P12](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P21](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0021), [v4 CHAPTER 19 DAWN AND DUSK P30](../source/v04-c19.md#nw-v04-c19-p0030)_

> Sitting in Anne's garden, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) tearfully confesses her past feelings of envy and resentment toward Anne's happiness. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) forgives her, and the two women reconcile, bond deeply over shared heartbreaks, and affirm their lasting friendship.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 21 BARRIERS SWEPT AWAY

> [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) drops [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) off at Anne's house before rushing away to an emergency. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks Owen to Leslie's home, chatting with him about his writing ambitions and connection to the area, before introducing him to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) and [Dick](../character/dick.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P1](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P8](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P17](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0017), [v4 CHAPTER 23 OWEN FORD COMES P34](../source/v04-c23.md#nw-v04-c23-p0034)_

> [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) gets Captain Jim's enthusiastic approval to write a novel based on his life-book and the memory of lost [Margaret](../character/margaret.md). Owen spends a wonderful summer working on the book at the lighthouse and enjoying outings with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). By September, Owen completes the novel and prepares to end his vacation, knowing he has written something extraordinary.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P3](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0003), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P9](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P14](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 25 THE WRITING OF THE BOOK P18](../source/v04-c25.md#nw-v04-c25-p0018)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accompanies [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) across the channel and encounters [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) walking alone in the foggy night on the sand-bar. Distressed over Owen Ford's departure, [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) confesses her unsought love for him to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) comforts her without revealing Owen's true feelings, and they bring [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) home with them in their boat.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P5](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P9](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P13](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0013), [v4 CHAPTER 27 ON THE SAND BAR P21](../source/v04-c27.md#nw-v04-c27-p0021)_

> Miss Cornelia visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and discusses funny obituaries, religious evangelists, and Owen Ford's effect on [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives, and later [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) shares her grief over her dog's death. After returning from a holiday trip to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) learn from Captain Jim that Owen's book based on his life story has been accepted for publication.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P0](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P12](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P26](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0026), [v4 CHAPTER 28 ODDS AND ENDS P35](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0035)_

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) consults Captain Jim, who surprisingly agrees that [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) should be told about the possibility of an operation for [Dick](../character/dick.md). [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) informs [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), who cold-bloodedly decides to take [Dick](../character/dick.md) to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) for the procedure, despite Anne's fears for her happiness. Afterwards, Miss Cornelia confronts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in anger over Gilbert's intervention, though she eventually accepts that the decision is made.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P4](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P22](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P30](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 30 LESLIE DECIDES P48](../source/v04-c30.md#nw-v04-c30-p0048)_

> [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) finances and undergoes the journey to [Montreal](../codex/places.md#montreal) with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) so [Dick](../character/dick.md) can have his operation. Later, after a successful surgery, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a shocking letter from [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) revealing that the man believed to be [Dick](../character/dick.md) is actually his cousin [George Moore](../character/george-moore.md).
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P1](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0001), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P5](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P8](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0008), [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028)_

> [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) returns home alone and visits [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her garden, recounting how George Moore's sister took him home after his memory returned. She shares her feelings of numbness, loneliness, and the lingering emotional strain of deciding to proceed with the operation.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P0](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0000), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P5](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0005), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P7](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 33 LESLIE RETURNS P12](../source/v04-c33.md#nw-v04-c33-p0012)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gives birth to a healthy baby boy, bringing immense joy and relief to the household after her previous loss. They decide to name the boy [James Matthew](../character/james-matthew.md), and the friends and family visit to admire the newborn while Miss Cornelia and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discuss Owen Ford's upcoming visit.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 34 THE SHIP O’DREAMS COMES TO HARBOR

> [Susan](../character/susan.md) leaves to care for her sister after an accident, and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) moves into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to stay with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) while [Susan](../character/susan.md) is away. [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) visits and meets [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) there, prompting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tell [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) that Owen has returned to court her.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P19](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0019), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P25](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P40](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0040), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P49](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0049)_

> [Owen Ford](../character/owen-ford.md) declares his love to [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) in the garden, and she joyfully returns his feelings. Later, Captain Jim joins [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Owen by the fireplace to share a solemn farewell and bestow a loving blessing upon them all. After the guests depart, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) congratulates [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md), and [Susan](../character/susan.md) returns from the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) with gossip about [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) Bryant's upcoming marriage.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P9](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0009), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P10](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0010), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P15](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0015), [v4 CHAPTER 38 RED ROSES P28](../source/v04-c38.md#nw-v04-c38-p0028)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) deliver Owen Ford's published life-book to Captain Jim, who hosts them for tea and celebrates the long-awaited occasion. The next morning, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) notice the lighthouse lamp is still lit past sunrise and hasten to investigate. They enter the lighthouse to find Captain Jim has peacefully passed away in his sleep with his life-book on his chest.
>
> — v4 · CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P4](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0004), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P11](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0011), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P16](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0016), [v4 CHAPTER 39 CAPTAIN JIM CROSSES THE BAR P28](../source/v04-c39.md#nw-v04-c39-p0028)_

> [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) proposes buying the [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) place in the [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) to accommodate their growing needs, leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) heartbroken at the prospect of leaving her house of dreams. [Susan](../character/susan.md) welcomes the move for practical reasons, but [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is only comforted when [Leslie](../character/leslie-moore.md) reveals that Owen intends to buy their current home for summer vacations. Finally, after packing up the house, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) bids an emotional farewell to her beloved home.
>
